title: Publish, sync, hooks and extensions follow-ups: gitlinks and merge commits classed right, newline paths and contribute scans checked, the scan form bumped, uninstall reads its result, team-clone promises kept or reworded, settings and extension loading robust
goal: kbpublic answers a path with a newline as unreadable; kbpublic.SCAN_FORM is bumped; kblane.commit_paths classes a gitlink replaced by a file as code; kg_hooks.new_lanes leaves a kb gitlink of a merge commit out; kg_contrib.added_hits passes each file's root; install-hooks --uninstall reads whether git config --unset succeeded; kb_mcp --register-local names a missing project directory; the coord hook posts no intent for a settings.json that is not valid JSON; group_gate skips a kb directory whose name is not a plain name; load_group_commands finds an entry point under extension_paths; ql_capture removes a stale takeover guard only while it holds the remover's token; extending.md says what file_hits passes a leak_scan extender; the commit-msg hook comment says the stray lines refuse the commit
